about: The fighting compartment's shell above the racks, as sections lofted by tools/blender/build_cabin_interior.py (roadmap I1, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 15). Body frame, metres: x right, y forward, z up. Read off the wide photos through their solved cameras (tools/traces/osa_interior/views/): a line along the hull gives one ray in the (x, z) section, a line across it one ray in (y, z). The photos show a 9A33BM3-1 (decision D1: shape from the BM3-1 where the AK shares it).
confidence_scale: high: measured against a traced face; medium: one ray and a stated constraint; low: read by eye or an estimate kept for closure

roof_section.about: The lining's underside, half a section from the rack's top in to the centre line, the same on both sides, from the rear bulkhead forward over the cab to the cab's front band (cab_front). The photos see it only from the rack face inwards; outboard of the racks it is hidden and the old flat lining is kept.

half.what: where the lining comes down behind the rack's top, outboard of the beam's end
half.source: mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 (the racks' tops at 2.10, data/cabins/osa_ak.json); hidden in every photo. Placed outboard of the beam's end (x 0.77), whose lit face wwp_gecko g092-a shows ending in a vertical edge

half.what: the ledge's rolled lip in front of the rack's top rail, a shadow gap under it
half.source: wwp_gecko g092-a (SP-2M2's solved camera): the lip's ray, dz/dx 0.449 from the eye, re-measured by edge profiles (the rail's is 0.416, the crease's 0.51-0.53), meets g094-a d04's lip mirrored, z = 1.82 + 0.33 (x + 0.45), at x 0.65

half.what: the lining's crease, where the sloping ledge meets the roof panel
half.source: wwp_gecko g092-a's crease ray (2.17 at x 0.5) and g094-a d01's (2.24 mirrored), which disagree by 0.05 m; the plan width of 0.1-0.15 m from g092-a d03

half.what: the roof panel at the centre line
half.source: wwp_gecko g092-a: the beam's top arris (2.245 at y 0.80), where the panel meets it

beam.what: The box beam across the compartment, at the forward edge of the turret's opening; its forward face is the light vertical face g092-a and g096-a show (g092-a d01-d03 first read it as a cornice along the wall). It stops short of the walls
beam.source: wwp_gecko g092-a: both arrises' rays in (y, z) are constant along the beam within 0.004, so it runs square across; the lower ray meets the racks' top height of 2.10 at y 0.80, where the upper ray gives 2.245. The depth fore and aft is unseen (estimate). The end: the lit face's left end in g092-a, cast to the plane y 0.80, x 0.765; the other end by symmetry. CHANGED 9 Nov 2026 by the depth comparison: g092-a's rays fix only a line in (y, z), and 0.80 came from assuming the lower arris meets the racks' top height. tools/recon/holistic_diff.py measure, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 33: wwp_gecko g096-a registered on the traced racks: the lower arris at y 0.546, z 2.199, the upper at y 0.565, z 2.288; the fused photos' surfaces show the band at y 0.52-0.62 from x -0.95 to 0.45. Fore and aft depth kept
beam.centre_source_nov9: wwp_gecko g096-a registered, holistic_diff measure on three stretches of the band: a vertical plane at y 0.65-0.74 from x -0.98 to 0.56, bottom z 2.175-2.196 (g096-a's row 0.10 on y 0.66 gives 2.186). It runs wall to wall and is not centred on x 0: nor is the compartment between its racks (-1.10, 0.61)

roof_pocket.what: The lining forward of the band stands higher than the roof panel: the band's whole height shows in g096-a, so nothing hangs below the rays that reach its top
roof_pocket.source: wwp_gecko g096-a, adjusted solve: the band's top row (0.017 of the frame) is z 2.30 on y 0.66, and that ray passes y 0.8 at z 2.26 and y 1.0 at z 2.19, so the lining between is above them. Its shape is unseen: SAM3D's choice, a plain recess

turret_opening.what: The turret's base in the roof, drawn as a dark near-circle until I4 builds the skirt and drive: the lining ends at it in a soft ragged roll round a white-painted metal collar
turret_opening.source: wwp_gecko g100-b d02-d04, d12: the casting's rim fits one ellipse across the vehicle, 0.63 wide to long, which is a circle seen about 51 degrees off the axis: an inference, the photo cannot prove it (the even gap to the rotating casting favours it). The forward edge at the beam's aft face (0.65), g096-a d06-d08. Forward edge kept on the beam's aft face, so it moved with the beam (9 Nov 2026)
turret_opening.reread_nov9: wwp_gecko g096-a (rendered through its registered camera against the photo): the opening spans 720 of the frame's 1000 columns where the model's ring spanned 620, centred 55-60 columns to the left of it, its aft rim at row 0.236 (z about 2.2: y -0.52) and its forward rim behind the band; the boot beside it likewise. half_x 0.78, centre (-0.16, 0.02), half_y 0.55, so its forward rim is behind the band; the lining's padded lip a little over the former roll (holistic_diff render, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 33)

boot.what: The grey canvas boot round the turret's central column, hanging from the opening down behind the cabinet, slightly narrower at its foot, the hem laced
boot.source: wwp_gecko g096-a d06-d23 and g100-b: its edges cast through g096-a's solved camera (tools/recon/holistic_sfm.py) to the plane y -0.1, widths 0.48 and 0.38 m across; on the hull's centre line by symmetry; how far down it hangs is hidden behind the cabinet, an estimate; its foot: the depth maps' fused cloud has almost nothing within 0.3 m of the axis below z 1.8, and g100-a, g100-c and g099-d see past where it would hang (docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 31)

base.what: Above the opening: the turret's olive base casting with its gearbox housing and a tan drum, drawn as a shallow relief on the opening's plane until the drive is modelled
base.source: wwp_gecko g100-b d-series (session A), g096-a (the same stencilled drum and casting); places by eye in the opening

wheel_arch_right.what: The wheel-arch housing at the right wall aft of SP-2M2: a box with a sloped top rising aft, forward face about 0.3 m high, standing inboard of the rack's carcass
wheel_arch_right.source: wwp_gecko g092-a d33-d34 cast to the floor at z 0.62 (corners at x 0.53-0.73, y -0.1 to 0.45) and their size cues; g096-a d39 (top at knee height)

rear_cove.what: The roof's rear lining coming down onto the bulkhead, across the width behind the turret's opening
rear_cove.source: wwp_gecko g096-a d15: the crease stands about 0.09 m above the door's top at the door's scale. The forward edge: the turret opening's aft edge (estimate)

cab_front.what: The cab's roof ends at a flat front band across the cab: the lining carries on from the compartment, without the step the first pass had at y 3.5, and the band drops to the header over the windscreens, which keeps the old 2.10. A lip over the panes under it
cab_front.source: wwp_gecko g082-b and g089-d (no solved camera, read by eye): the lining runs on forward light grey-green to a flat band with the type plate, then a narrow header, a recess and a lip over the panes. The band's place is an estimate ahead of the hatches (their forward edge 4.10). Photos of the 9A33BM3-1 show one large central opening with a deep coaming where voenizdat_osa_1991 p173 and the cabin keep the hatches: I5

bulkhead.about: The rear bulkhead's face, seen looking aft: +x is on the photo's left. The door sits high, over a low flap, and hinges on its outboard side. g096-a and g100-a are not posed; their scale is the door's, and the door's width is the plan's.

door.what: The door to the engine compartment, inside its seal, high on the bulkhead
door.source: mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 (the opening at x 0 to 0.59); wwp_gecko g100-a (height to width 1.37, corner radius a twelfth of the width); g096-a (the door's top level with the lamp, the top from the aisle's vanishing point, the cabinet's top taken as 1.70)

door_frame.what: The pressed convex bead round the opening
door_frame.source: wwp_gecko g100-a: 0.02 to 0.05 m wide round the seal, the wider on the latch side; drawn uniform

door_fittings.what: On the door: four pressed channels with five screws each, two hinge pads on the outboard side, two dog levers and a strap handle in a pressed pocket on the centre-line side
door_fittings.source: wwp_gecko g100-a, square to the door: the door's seal 1049 x 1437 px, scaled by its width 0.58 m to 1809 px/m. Distances from the seal's outboard edge and from its top. g096-a confirms the channels' and the handle's places

ledge.what: The box ledge over the door, under the lining
ledge.source: wwp_gecko g096-a d46 (0.09 m over the door's top at the door's scale; its square lower edge is read level with the door's top, kept here just clear of the frame's bead); it stops at the boot, x 0.19

rib.what: The vertical raised strip between the corner fairing and the door's frame
rib.source: wwp_gecko g096-a d45, at the door's scale

fairing.what: The rounded vertical fairing in the corner between the bulkhead and the right rack's aft end
fairing.source: wwp_gecko g096-a d44, at the door's scale. Hidden for now behind SP-3M's carcass, whose face the cabin has at x 0.667 where this photo puts it about 0.85 at the bulkhead: settled with SL-3M's size (roadmap I3)

lower_step.what: The bulkhead's lower part stepping out under the door, its top a lit lip across the whole width
lower_step.source: wwp_gecko g100-a d31: a fifth of the door's width below the door's bottom seal

flap.what: The low flap in the step under the door, hung on a piano hinge along its top
flap.source: wwp_gecko g100-a (the hinge and the flap's width, at the door's scale), g096-a (its height, at the door's scale); g100-a d54 (the piano hinge's short knuckles over a brass pin)

door_detail.what: On the door: the red warning plate, the black lever-positions plate, the hinge pockets' screws, the latches' base plates and keepers, the handle's screws and two lone studs. Legends are not drawn (decals, roadmap I10)
door_detail.source: wwp_gecko g100-a (traced in tools/traces/osa_interior/details/g100-a.json), mapped by the door's seal: 0.58 m across its width; session A, the door's width from mon_2112_80 Fig. 3

hood.what: The blue-grey sheet hood standing out from the bulkhead above the blower opening, its lower face sloping; a small screwed cover at its top, brass screws, a grey tube across its front
hood.source: wwp_gecko g100-a (traced in tools/traces/osa_interior/details/g100-a.json), mapped by the door's seal: 0.58 m across its width; session A, the door's width from mon_2112_80 Fig. 3. Cut by the photo's edge: its far end (x -0.42) and its depth out of the wall are estimates

blower.what: The blower's tall framed opening in the bulkhead: a light sheet frame, a black ring round a cream hub in its lower half, a plate closing its foot, brass screws round it. Drawn as a dark recess: a true hole would break the wall for Lumen
blower.source: wwp_gecko g100-a (traced in tools/traces/osa_interior/details/g100-a.json), mapped by the door's seal: 0.58 m across its width; session A, the door's width from mon_2112_80 Fig. 3. Cut by the photo's edge: its far side (x -0.38) is an estimate

aft_fittings.about: Fittings at the rear of the compartment that the model lacked (docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 36)

hung_motor.what: The round electrical machine hung under the roof left of the centre line: a wide drum, a narrower upper body, a flange and a blue-grey mount up to the lining, a square box beside it. What it is has not been identified
hung_motor.source: wwp_gecko g099-a and g100-c, tools/recon/holistic_diff.py: the axis and radius from g099-a's two silhouette rays and five points of g100-c's lower rim, the heights along g099-a's rays at the axis; holistic_diff finding F002 (3 views, the surface 0.28 m in front of the model)

dark_box.what: The dark box on the bulkhead under the hung machine
dark_box.source: wwp_gecko g099-a, tools/recon/holistic_diff.py: its corners through the depth map (the bulkhead-distance is the network's, not triangulated)

blower_cover.what: The grey sheet cover standing proud over the outboard part of the blower opening, leaving a slit at the ring
blower_cover.source: wwp_gecko g100-c at the blower frame's scale (its width 0.183 m, bulkhead.blower)

sloped_box.what: The small sloped-top box low on the bulkhead below the blower
sloped_box.source: wwp_gecko g100-c and g100-d at the blower frame's scale

plinth_aft_right.what: The stepped plinth at the right, between the wheel arch and the bulkhead: a vertical face and a top sloping down inboard
plinth_aft_right.source: wwp_gecko g096-a d40, d113, g098-a, g092-a d34; the depth maps' fused cloud (tools/recon/holistic_depth.py, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 31) and the triangulated points: the top rises from 0.9 at x 0.2 to 1.13 at x 0.5

step_forward_right.what: The raised step along the right of the aisle under the right R-123M: a dark plate over a light grey aft face
step_forward_right.source: wwp_gecko g082-b d115 (no camera, read by eye); along the box's length in the cabin, its outboard edge the rack's face (data/cabins/osa_ak.json)

nosing_cab_right.what: The bright aluminium strip across the floor aft of the commander's mat
nosing_cab_right.source: wwp_gecko g082-b d83 (no camera, read by eye); the mat's aft edge from the cabin

floor.not_built: The cabinet's plinth (g096-a d86) waits for the 0096-9M's stance, which the game keeps turned as the AK's own drawing has it. The left wheel arch: no photo sees it and the GA-3 stands there in the plan. The sponson under the left rack (g082-b d14): part of the rack's lower carcass, I2. The aft left ledge and its three bosses (g100-d, g099-d) and the plates and mat forward of the bench (g083-b, g088-a, g085-c): their places wait for the cross-aisle decision (docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 16).

spine.what: The aisle's pressed floor from the rack side to the bench's base: one sheet, slightly proud, with two long pressed ridges bounding a band of transverse ribs, and a plain strip on the bench's side
spine.source: wwp_gecko g093-c d01-d08, d11 (its edge at x 0.45 cast through the camera from the joint solve of the book's photos (tools/recon/holistic_sfm.py); the ridges' places as fractions of its width, the ribs' pitch from five in view); g095-d (the same ribs). The bench-side edge is the bench's base, the cabin's; its height: the depth maps' fused cloud (tools/recon/holistic_depth.py, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 31) and the triangulated points (0.2 m above the hull floor at its aft part; the first reading of 0.632 came from one camera)

forward_step.x_from_source: wwp_gecko photos through the fused depth maps' floor map (tools/recon/holistic_diff.py surfaces, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 34): forward of y 1.45 the walkway reads 0.79-0.80 left of the channel (about 22 000 pixels) and 0.675 right of it
forward_step.source: wwp_gecko g093-c, g095-d, the depth maps' fused cloud (tools/recon/holistic_depth.py, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 31) and the triangulated points: 0.82-0.84 up to y 1.4, 0.72-0.74 forward of it

channel.what: the pressed channel along the walkway, right of the centre line (the walkway's stepped pressed edges, g093-c)
channel.source: wwp_gecko photos through the depth comparison's floor map (tools/recon/holistic_diff.py surfaces, section 33): 0.685-0.700 across x 0.03-0.13 where the walkway reads 0.77-0.79, and 0.625 against 0.65-0.71 forward of the step

spine.level_source_nov9: Re-read with the adjusted cameras (section 33): the floor map reads 0.77-0.79 aft and 0.65-0.71 forward across x 0.18-0.48, and the triangulated points of the walkway 0.77-0.78; section 31's 0.83 and 0.73 came from the unadjusted cameras.

trough_right.what: The dark strip of floor along the right rack's foot: dark plate with a black gap in it under the rack, earth straps over its plate. Not a pit: the camera stands inboard of the edge (eye x -0.13, edge x 0.45), so the dark line at the edge faces the aisle and this strip cannot lie below the spine, as first read
trough_right.source: wwp_gecko g093-c d03, d12-d17, g095-d; the level from the solved camera's side of the edge (the joint solve of the book's photos (tools/recon/holistic_sfm.py))

bench_base_bays.what: The face of the bench's base along the aisle: five boxes with chamfered corners, which the photos read as a raised step
bench_base_bays.source: wwp_gecko g093-c d19-d21, g095-c; raised with the walkway it stands on, up to the bench's top (the depth maps' fused cloud (tools/recon/holistic_depth.py, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 31) and the triangulated points)

stair_plates_aft.what: The aisle's aft end: two plates in stairs down towards the front
stair_plates_aft.source: wwp_gecko g093-c d22-d24 (the stair, seen across the aisle's end); the heights estimated: one step about a hand high

hatch_round_aft_left.what: A round bolted hatch in the floor by the aft left corner, dished in the middle, eight flange bolts
hatch_round_aft_left.source: wwp_gecko g100-d d-series and g099-d (bolts traced in both); placed from its cast through g100-d's solved camera as a fraction of the aisle's width; session A, same type, may differ

arch_forward_right.what: The forward end of the right wheel-arch housing, reaching into the aisle ahead of the old box: rounded on the aisle side in plan, its top rising aft
arch_forward_right.source: 257 points of the joint solve of the book's photos (tools/recon/holistic_sfm.py) at x 0.32-0.62, y 0.32-0.81, z 0.79-1.09, seen by wwp_gecko g093-c, g092-a, g096-a, g098-a; the plan's curve from its relief map. Replaces the first reading (x 0.6-0.7), which was a guess from the visible corners. The solve reaches x 0.32; the side is held at 0.43, clear of the crew's walk (data/cabins/osa_ak.json, x up to 0.42), until the aisle's width is decided

raised.what: The rear floor left of the plinth, higher than the aisle's base: level round the bolted hatch, rising towards the aisle's stair
raised.source: tools/recon/holistic_diff.py cloud (wwp_gecko g099-a, g099-d, g100-a, g100-c, g100-d through their fused depth maps), docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 37: median z 0.70-0.77 for y -1.0 to -0.5 and 0.79 at y -0.37, x -0.85 to -0.25, where the old floor was 0.62

raised.what: The raised strip along the inboard side of the rear floor
raised.source: tools/recon/holistic_diff.py cloud (wwp_gecko g099-a, g099-d, g100-a, g100-c, g100-d through their fused depth maps), docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 37: median z 0.84-0.86 for x -0.25 to -0.1, y -0.85 to -0.5

raised.what: The raised floor directly beneath the 0096-9M2: flat at 0.95, its forward edge sloping down to the walkway; the cabinet's connectors come down on it
raised.source: tools/recon/holistic_diff.py measure, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 33: wwp_gecko g096-a registered on the traced racks: the top at z 0.954 for y 0.53-0.60 (normal within 7 degrees of vertical), the sloped plate with the data plate at y 0.62-0.70, z 0.89-0.95, 41 degrees. Top lowered 7 cm on the fused depth map, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 35: z 0.87-0.89 for y 0.40-0.60 (the sloped front at y 0.69-0.73, z 0.81-0.86 as before)

Each section's points match, in order, the other's
raised.source: tools/recon/holistic_diff.py measure and the fused depth maps, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 35: wwp_gecko g096-a: the panel's top edge from (0.01, 0.23, 1.00) to (0.42, 0.25, 1.12), its lower edge from (-0.01, 0.23, 0.90) to (0.38, 0.33, 0.98), the top behind it to (0.42, 0.15, 1.13) and (0.09, -0.06, 1.00), the lower housing's front 38 degrees from the floor at y 0.36-0.44, a flat top at z 0.85 for y 0.43-0.52, the floor at 0.76 forward of y 0.5. The section at x 0.47 is the measured slope carried 5 cm on to the corner plate

raised.what: The sloped filler where the right wall's post meets the floor, forward of the post
raised.source: tools/recon/holistic_diff.py measure, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 33: wwp_gecko g096-a registered on the traced racks: a plane at x 0.47-0.57, y 0.52-0.67, z 0.97-1.14, facing the aisle, forward and up (normal -0.58, 0.56, 0.59)

roof_details.about: What hangs on the lining and is not its section

insulators.what: Six white stand-off insulators on short stems along the right lining's lower edge, carrying a grey cable aft to the bulkhead lamp
insulators.source: wwp_gecko g098-a d04, d05 and g098-b d03, cast through g098-a's solved camera to the edge's height 2.10 (the joint solve of the book's photos (tools/recon/holistic_sfm.py)); session A. g096-a (hangar session) reads them as lining studs with no cable: a possible difference between the two photos

seams.what: The soft padded lining's pressed-in seams across the compartment forward of the beam, and its welted edge along each side
seams.source: wwp_gecko g098-a, g098-b (cloth with pleated seams, no stitching), g100-b, g096-a; the seams' pitch is an estimate. The cab's roof forward of them is paint, not cloth (g089-a, g089-c)

posts.about: The bent pressed posts between the racks that the first shell did not have. Each is a channel running floor to lining, its foot flaring, drawn as a closed section between its outline on the rack side and the rack

right.what: Right post: upright to about 1.55 m, then a leg raking inboard to the wheel arch, a wide gusset behind it
right.source: The depth maps' fused cloud, points two or more views agree on (tools/recon/holistic_depth.py, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 31): the aisle-side edge of the post's forward face, y 0.33-0.55; wwp_gecko g096-a, g098-a. Below 0.96 hidden, SAM3D's

right.leg_y_source_nov9: tools/recon/holistic_diff.py measure, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 33: wwp_gecko g096-a registered on the traced racks: the slanted part at y 0.36-0.46, and the leg's points at 0.3-0.47

left.what: Left post: the printed tables on its upright part, the same rake inboard below about 1.55 m (T-handles on the leg)
left.source: The depth maps' fused cloud, points two or more views agree on (tools/recon/holistic_depth.py, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 31): the aisle-side edge of the post's forward face, y 0.33-0.55, across the aisle scaled about the right rack by 0.847 as the racks are; wwp_gecko g096-a, g099-b. left.y_source_nov9: tools/recon/holistic_diff.py measure, docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 33: wwp_gecko g096-a registered on the traced racks: the forward face of the column with the placard at y 0.31-0.345 (x -1.13 to -1.03, z 1.50-2.02); the slanted part at y 0.28-0.36. Was y 0.64

lower_side_wall.what: Below the racks' blocks the side walls rake inboard towards the floor: the wheel boxes' and sponsons' inner plates. The hull's outer sides are upright down to about 0.9 m, so this is the inside of the wheel boxes, not a leaning hull
lower_side_wall.source: wwp_gecko g096-a (posts cast through the joint solve: 0.34), g098-a, g098-c (the first-aid box leaning on that wall, triangulated: 0.36), g082-b (the sloping plates under both front racks, down to the deck's side)

cab_corner_posts.source: wwp_gecko g082-b, its camera on the mat's vanishing point, scaled by the seats' 0.50 m width (docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 30), g084-a; no camera to scale in the cab group
